PROPERTIES.clue_custom_text1: Even-numbered holes have an even number of occupants (this includes zero occupants).
PROPERTIES.clue_custom_text2: Odd-numbered holes have an odd number of occupants.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Per (B)'s clue, (H) can only be in Hole 1 with an unknown woman in a cart, either R12 C1 or R12 C4. Block the rest of R12. This isolates (M) on the Hole 3 flag, and (K) must be with (M) in R2.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Hole 3 is odd-numbered, so it must have 3 occupants. (O) is in R1 and cannot be on a golf tee per (G)'s clue, isolating (O) in R1 C12.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: (J) is either in R11 C5 or R14 C9, block the intersecting squares. This isolates (E) on the Hole 6 flag, then (J). Hole 4 must have two occupants and Hole 5 one. (K) cannot be in C13 - C16, isolating (K) in R2 C11.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: Because someone is in Hole 5 in R15 or R16, Hole 6 cannot have four occupants. It must have two: (E) and (J). Block the rest of Hole 6. Whoever is in R16 is the person in Hole 5, so block the rest of Hole 5. The person in R15 is in Hole 1.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: This isolates (G) on the last tee, then someone in R15 C1. The woman in the cart must be (F), with (I) in C3, so (H) is in R15 C1. Because Hole 2 is even-numbered, (G) must be paired with somebody in R4 C6.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: This isolates (D) on the last square beside a flag, then (I), then (A) on the last square beside water.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: (N) cannot be in Hole 2 per (F)'s clue, nor in Hole 8 per (L)'s clue. This isolates (N) in the last sand square in Hole 7, then (B), then (L) in Hole 8.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_8_en: (C) cannot be in C16, so he must be in Hole 2 with (G). This isolates (V) alone with (D). Breta is the murderer!
